correctness.rationale: Define B as coordinates at which all k members are pairwise distinct; each equality set is J-small, hence B is J*-large and B subset G_k. With He–Luo–Zhang Lemma 4.23, FSP iff U*-maximal for an ultrafilter U extending J*. Necessity: if C_k misses U, on U-large B\C_k there is a spare coordinate value (F>k, including infinity), giving h with no U-large agreement with any family member. Sufficiency: if C_k is J-positive, extend J* with C_k to U; on B∩C_k the k coordinate values exhaust F(n), and finite-union ultrafilter primeness makes any h agree on a U-large set with one member. The independent k-family existence condition G_k in J* follows by coordinatewise constant witnesses on G_k. k=1 and infinite F(n) covered; alternating Fin witness satisfies strict separation.
